method: Every source URL cited on a project page is read with one GET (redirects followed, robots.txt respected) once a week, one seventh each day. Live = final HTTP status 200-399. Changed = the SHA-256 of the visible text differs from the last read. Status r = robots.txt asks us not to read it; e = no answer (timeout, DNS, TLS); n = not read yet. A changed or dead source is a reason to look again, not a finding about the project.

archive_kinds.k: our archived text of the page (/projects/<slug>/changes/)
